title: Kamailio On FLOSS Weekly – Oct 16, 2019
html:
Fred Posner is the guest of FLOSS Weekly this week on Wednesday (October 16, 2019) to discuss about Kamailio SIP Server project.

You can tune in live and see how the session goes – it happens at 9:30am Pacific Time (-7 UTC) / 16:30 UTC. The host of the show is Randal L. Schwartz.

See more details at:

  • https://twit.tv/shows/floss-weekly

UPDATE: the recorded video of the session is available at:

  • https://twit.tv/shows/floss-weekly/episodes/551

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
